Package model.playlist.media

Class Media

java.lang.Object
model.playlist.media.Media
All Implemented Interfaces:
Playable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Podcast, ShortClip, Song
public abstract class Media extends Object implements Playable
The Media class is an abstract representation of various types of media such as songs, podcasts, or short clips. Media implements the Playable interface, ensuring that all media types can be played.
